q_vocab_c2_01_001.question: Que 'prosopopeya' signifier dans literary analysis?
q_vocab_c2_01_001.correct: personification (giving human qualities to non-human things)
wrong: prose style or narrative technique
the protagonist's inner monologue
a dramatic plot reversal
q_vocab_c2_01_001.explanation: 'Prosopopeya' est Le/La Espagnol term pour 'personification,' a rhetorical figure dans quel human attributes sont ascribed à animals, objects, ou abstract concepts. Il est widely used dans poetry et literary criticism.

q_vocab_c2_01_002.question: Que 'desenlace' signifier?
wrong: introduction of the story
climax of the narrative
a subplot within the main story
q_vocab_c2_01_002.explanation: 'Desenlace' se réfère à Le/La final resolution ou outcome de a literary plot. Il literally derives de 'desenlazar' (à untie), suggesting Le/La unraveling de Le/La narrative threads.

q_vocab_c2_01_003.question: El autor emplea la ___ para repetir una palabra al inicio de cada verso.
wrong: metáfora
hipérbole
elipsis
q_vocab_c2_01_003.explanation: 'Anáfora' est Le/La rhetorical device de repeating a mot ou phrase à Le/La beginning de successive clauses ou verses. Il creates rhythm et emphasis dans les deux poetry et prose.

q_vocab_c2_01_004.question: Que 'leitmotiv' signifier dans literary et artistic contexts?
q_vocab_c2_01_004.correct: a recurring theme or motif throughout a work
wrong: the moral lesson of a story
a brief introductory passage
the author's biographical influence
q_vocab_c2_01_004.explanation: 'Leitmotiv' (borrowed de German via music criticism) se réfère à a recurring theme, image, ou phrase Cela runs through an entire work, reinforcing son central ideas. Il est utilisé dans literature, film, et music analysis.

q_vocab_c2_01_005.question: Que 'sinécdoque' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_01_005.correct: a figure of speech where a part represents the whole or vice versa
wrong: a comparison using 'like' or 'as'
an exaggeration for rhetorical effect
the attribution of contradictory qualities
q_vocab_c2_01_005.explanation: 'Sinécdoque' est a type de metonymy où a part stands pour Le/La whole (e.g., 'vela' pour 'barco') ou Le/La whole pour a part. Il est a fundamental concept dans advanced rhetorical et literary analysis.

q_vocab_c2_01_006.question: Le/La author uses an oxymoron à create tension between opposing ideas.
q_vocab_c2_01_006.correct: El autor emplea un oxímoron para crear tensión entre ideas opuestas.
wrong: El autor emplea una metáfora para crear tensión entre ideas opuestas.
El autor emplea un símil para crear tensión entre ideas opuestas.
El autor emplea una anáfora para crear tensión entre ideas opuestas.
q_vocab_c2_01_006.explanation: An 'oxímoron' combines two contradictory terms (e.g., 'silencio atronador'). Il est a key literary device tested à C2 level, distinct de metaphor, simile, ou anaphora.

q_vocab_c2_01_007.question: Que 'verosimilitud' signifier dans literary criticism?
q_vocab_c2_01_007.correct: verisimilitude / the appearance of being true or plausible
wrong: the verified truth of a historical account
the author's personal credibility
the moral integrity of characters
q_vocab_c2_01_007.explanation: 'Verosimilitud' se réfère à comment believable ou realistic a fictional narrative appears à Le/La reader. A work avec high verosimilitud feels plausible within son own world, même si il est entirely invented.

q_vocab_c2_01_008.question: El narrador omnisciente conoce los pensamientos de todos los personajes.
q_vocab_c2_01_008.correct: The omniscient narrator knows the thoughts of all the characters.
wrong: The unreliable narrator hides the thoughts of all the characters.
The first-person narrator describes the thoughts of all the characters.
The omniscient narrator controls the actions of all the characters.
q_vocab_c2_01_008.explanation: 'Narrador omnisciente' signifie 'omniscient narrator,' a narrative voice avec unlimited knowledge de Le/La characters' inner lives et Le/La story's events. Il est a central concept dans narrative theory.

q_vocab_c2_01_009.question: Vous sont writing a literary essay à propos de a novel Cela deliberately breaks Le/La fourth wall. Quel term best décrit Ce technique?
wrong: intertextualidad
realismo mágico
corriente de conciencia
q_vocab_c2_01_009.explanation: 'Metaficción' se réfère à fiction Cela self-consciously addresses son own nature as a literary construct, souvent breaking Le/La fourth wall. Pendant que 'intertextualidad' involves references between texts, metafiction specifically foregrounds Le/La act de storytelling itself.
q_vocab_c2_01_009.context: Writing a literary analysis essay for an advanced course

q_vocab_c2_01_010.question: Un professeur vous demande d'identifier la technique narrative où les événements sont présentés dans le désordre chronologique, avec un retour à une époque antérieure. Quel terme est correct ?
wrong: prolepsis
elipsis narrativa
monólogo interior
q_vocab_c2_01_010.explanation: L'« analepsis » (aussi appelée « flashback » ou retour en arrière) est la technique narrative qui consiste à interrompre la séquence chronologique pour évoquer des événements d'une époque antérieure. La « prolepsis » est son contraire : une anticipation, un saut vers des événements futurs.
q_vocab_c2_01_010.context: A university literature seminar discussing narrative techniques

q_vocab_c2_02_001.question: Que 'epistemología' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_02_001.correct: epistemology (the branch of philosophy studying the nature of knowledge)
wrong: the study of infectious diseases
the science of language origins
the classification of living organisms
q_vocab_c2_02_001.explanation: 'Epistemología' est Le/La philosophical discipline Cela examines Le/La nature, origin, et limits de human knowledge. Il asks questions like 'Que peut we know?' et 'Comment do we justify beliefs?'

q_vocab_c2_02_002.question: La ___ estudia los sistemas de control y comunicación en máquinas y seres vivos.
wrong: lingüística
termodinámica
antropología
q_vocab_c2_02_002.explanation: 'Cibernética' (cybernetics) est Le/La interdisciplinary study de regulatory et communication systems dans les deux machines et living organisms. Il était pioneered par Norbert Wiener dans Le/La mid-20th century.

q_vocab_c2_02_003.question: Que 'macroeconomía' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_02_003.correct: macroeconomics (the study of economy-wide phenomena like inflation and GDP)
wrong: the study of individual consumer behavior
the management of corporate finances
the regulation of international trade agreements
q_vocab_c2_02_003.explanation: 'Macroeconomía' est Le/La branch de economics Cela analyzes large-scale economic factors tel que national output, unemployment rates, et inflation. Il contrasts avec 'microeconomía,' quel focuses sur individual agents.

q_vocab_c2_02_004.question: Que 'jurisprudencia' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_02_004.correct: jurisprudence (the theory and philosophy of law, or body of court rulings)
wrong: a jury's final verdict in a trial
the legislative process of creating laws
the enforcement of criminal penalties
q_vocab_c2_02_004.explanation: 'Jurisprudencia' a a dual sens: il refers les deux à Le/La philosophy de law as an academic discipline et à Le/La body de judicial decisions Cela serve as precedent. En espagnol legal contexts, il frequently denotes established case law.

q_vocab_c2_02_005.question: Le/La researcher proposed a nouveau paradigm pour understanding consciousness.
q_vocab_c2_02_005.correct: El investigador propuso un nuevo paradigma para entender la conciencia.
wrong: El investigador propuso un nuevo método para entender la ciencia.
El investigador propuso un nuevo paradigma para entender la competencia.
El investigador rechazó un nuevo paradigma para entender la conciencia.
q_vocab_c2_02_005.explanation: 'Paradigma' signifie 'paradigm,' a fundamental framework de assumptions et methods within quel research est conducted. 'Conciencia' signifie 'consciousness' (ou 'conscience,' depending sur context).

q_vocab_c2_02_006.question: Que 'heurístico' signifier dans academic et scientific contexts?
q_vocab_c2_02_006.correct: heuristic (relating to a practical problem-solving approach, not guaranteed to be optimal)
wrong: hermetic or completely sealed from outside influence
heretical or contrary to established doctrine
heroic or demonstrating exceptional bravery
q_vocab_c2_02_006.explanation: 'Heurístico' décrit methods ou strategies Cela use practical shortcuts à find satisfactory solutions, surtout quand an exhaustive analysis serait impractical. Il est widely used dans computer science, psychology, et philosophy.

q_vocab_c2_02_007.question: A colleague à a research conference mentions Cela Le/La study uses a 'metodología cualitativa.' Dans quel scenario est Ce la plupart appropriate?
q_vocab_c2_02_007.correct: A study analyzing in-depth interviews to understand participants' lived experiences
wrong: A study measuring the statistical correlation between two numerical variables
A study running controlled laboratory experiments with large sample sizes
A study computing regression models from quantitative survey data
q_vocab_c2_02_007.explanation: 'Metodología cualitativa' (qualitative methodology) focuses sur understanding sens, experiences, et social phenomena through non-numerical data tel que interviews, observations, et textual analysis. Il contrasts avec quantitative methods Cela rely sur numerical measurement.
q_vocab_c2_02_007.context: An academic research conference discussing study design

q_vocab_c2_02_008.question: Que 'ontología' signifier dans philosophy?
q_vocab_c2_02_008.correct: ontology (the study of the nature of being and existence)
wrong: the study of moral values and ethical behavior
the study of the origin of the universe
the study of language and its structure
q_vocab_c2_02_008.explanation: 'Ontología' est Le/La branch de metaphysics Cela investigates Le/La fundamental nature de reality, existence, et being. Il asks que entities exist et comment ils peut être grouped et related.

q_vocab_c2_02_009.question: Los datos empíricos corroboran la hipótesis planteada por el equipo de investigación.
q_vocab_c2_02_009.correct: The empirical data corroborate the hypothesis put forward by the research team.
wrong: The theoretical data contradict the hypothesis put forward by the research team.
The empirical data refute the methodology proposed by the research team.
The empirical data corroborate the conclusion rejected by the research team.
q_vocab_c2_02_009.explanation: 'Datos empíricos' signifie 'empirical data' (based sur observation ou experiment). 'Corroborar' signifie 'à corroborate' ou 'à confirm.' 'Hipótesis planteada' signifie 'hypothesis put forward.'

q_vocab_c2_02_010.question: Vous sont reviewing an academic paper et need pour décrire an argument Cela commits a logical fallacy par assuming que il tries à prove. Quel term do vous use?
wrong: argumento ad hominem
falacia naturalista
reducción al absurdo
q_vocab_c2_02_010.explanation: 'Petición de principio' (begging Le/La question / circular reasoning) occurs quand an argument's premise presupposes Le/La truth de son conclusion. An 'ad hominem' attacks Le/La personne, a 'falacia naturalista' derives 'ought' de 'est,' et 'reducción al absurdo' disproves par showing absurd consequences.

q_vocab_c2_03_001.question: Que Le/La mot 'coche' refer à dans Spain, et Quels sont son equivalents dans Latin America?
q_vocab_c2_03_001.correct: car (called 'carro' in most of Latin America and 'auto' in Argentina/Chile)
wrong: bus (called 'camión' in Mexico)
truck (called 'camioneta' in Colombia)
bicycle (called 'bici' everywhere)
q_vocab_c2_03_001.explanation: 'Coche' est Le/La standard mot pour 'car' dans Spain. Dans Mexico et beaucoup de Central America, 'carro' est preferred, pendant que dans Argentina et Chile, 'auto' (short pour 'automóvil') est more commun.

q_vocab_c2_03_002.question: Que 'piso' signifier dans Spain versus Latin America?
q_vocab_c2_03_002.correct: In Spain it means 'apartment'; in Latin America it primarily means 'floor'
wrong: In Spain it means 'floor'; in Latin America it means 'apartment'
In both regions it exclusively means 'story of a building'
In Spain it means 'house'; in Latin America it means 'balcony'
q_vocab_c2_03_002.explanation: Dans Spain, 'piso' couramment signifie 'apartment' (equivalent à 'apartamento' ou 'departamento' dans Latin America). Dans Latin America, 'piso' primarily se réfère à 'floor' ou 'ground.' Ceci est un classic regional vocabulary difference.

q_vocab_c2_03_003.question: En México, los niños toman el ___ para ir a la escuela, pero en España lo llaman 'autobús.'
wrong: carro
metro
taxi
q_vocab_c2_03_003.explanation: Dans Mexico, 'camión' colloquially signifie 'bus' (pour public transport), whereas dans Spain et la plupart other countries 'camión' seulement signifie 'truck.' Mexicans say 'tomar el camión' où Spaniards say 'coger el autobús.'

q_vocab_c2_03_004.question: Que 'coger' signifier dans Spain versus la plupart de Latin America?
q_vocab_c2_03_004.correct: In Spain it means 'to take/grab'; in much of Latin America it is vulgar slang
wrong: In Spain it means 'to cook'; in Latin America it means 'to eat'
In Spain it means 'to run'; in Latin America it means 'to walk'
It means 'to choose' in both regions without any difference
q_vocab_c2_03_004.explanation: 'Coger' est a perfectly neutral verbe dans Spain sens 'à take' ou 'à grab' (e.g., 'coger el autobús'). Cependant, dans Argentina, Mexico, et other Latin American countries, il a a vulgar sexual connotation, donc 'tomar' ou 'agarrar' sont utilisés instead.

q_vocab_c2_03_005.question: Que 'computadora' signifier, et Où est il used instead de 'ordenador'?
q_vocab_c2_03_005.correct: It means 'computer' and is used in Latin America; 'ordenador' is used in Spain
wrong: It means 'calculator' and is used in Argentina only
It means 'computer' and is used in Spain; 'ordenador' is used in Latin America
It means 'printer' and is used in Central America
q_vocab_c2_03_005.explanation: 'Computadora' (de Anglais 'computer') est Le/La standard mot pour 'computer' throughout Latin America. Dans Spain, 'ordenador' (de French 'ordinateur') est utilisé instead. Les deux sont perfectly correct dans leur respective regions.

q_vocab_c2_03_006.question: I'm going à take Le/La elevator à Le/La fifth floor.
q_vocab_c2_03_006.correct: Voy a tomar el ascensor hasta el quinto piso.
wrong: Voy a tomar el elevador hasta el quinto suelo.
Voy a coger las escaleras hasta el quinto piso.
Voy a subir el ascensor hasta el quinto nivel.
q_vocab_c2_03_006.explanation: Dans Latin America, 'elevador' est commun, pendant que dans Spain, 'ascensor' est Le/La standard term pour 'elevator/lift.' Les deux sont understood everywhere, mais Le/La regional preference matters à C2 level. 'Tomar' est Le/La safe neutral verbe across tous regions.

q_vocab_c2_03_007.question: Que 'vos' represent dans Le/La context de regional Espagnol differences?
q_vocab_c2_03_007.correct: A second-person singular pronoun used in Argentina, Uruguay, and parts of Central America instead of 'tú'
wrong: A formal second-person pronoun used in Spain instead of 'usted'
A third-person plural pronoun used in the Caribbean
An archaic first-person plural pronoun no longer in use
q_vocab_c2_03_007.explanation: 'Vos' est le pronom used dans 'voseo,' a linguistic phenomenon où 'vos' replaces 'tú' avec distinct verbe conjugations (e.g., 'vos tenés' instead de 'tú tienes'). Il est standard dans Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay, et parts de Central America.

q_vocab_c2_03_008.question: En España se dice 'zumo de naranja,' pero en Latinoamérica se dice 'jugo de naranja.'
q_vocab_c2_03_008.correct: In Spain they say 'zumo de naranja,' but in Latin America they say 'jugo de naranja.'
wrong: In Spain they say 'jugo de naranja,' but in Latin America they say 'zumo de naranja.'
In Spain they say 'néctar de naranja,' but in Latin America they say 'zumo de naranja.'
In Spain they say 'zumo de naranja,' but in Latin America they say 'licuado de naranja.'
q_vocab_c2_03_008.explanation: 'Zumo' (Spain) et 'jugo' (Latin America) les deux signifier 'juice.' C'est one de Le/La la plupart well-known vocabulary differences between peninsular et Latin American Espagnol.

q_vocab_c2_03_009.question: Vous sont writing a formel document pour a Pan-Hispanic audience. Vous need à refer à a mobile phone. Quel term est Le/La la plupart universally understood?
wrong: celular
móvil
teléfono celular
q_vocab_c2_03_009.explanation: Pendant que 'celular' dominates dans Latin America et 'móvil' est standard dans Spain, Le/La full form 'teléfono móvil' est Le/La la plupart universally understood et formally neutral term. Pour Pan-Hispanic documents, avoiding strongly regional terms ensures clarity across tous audiences.
q_vocab_c2_03_009.context: Drafting a formal Pan-Hispanic corporate communication

q_vocab_c2_03_010.question: A Espagnol speaker de Mexico says 'Me voy a estacionar.' A speaker de Spain serait more likely say quel de Le/La following?
wrong: Voy a estacionar.
Voy a parquear.
Voy a detener.
q_vocab_c2_03_010.explanation: 'Estacionar' (Mexico), 'aparcar' (Spain), et 'parquear' (Colombia, Caribbean) tous signifier 'à park (a vehicle).' Recognizing ces regional synonyms est essential à C2 level. 'Aparcar' est Le/La standard peninsular Espagnol form.
q_vocab_c2_03_010.context: Comparing how different Spanish speakers describe parking a car

q_vocab_c2_04_001.question: Que 'banco' signifier quand il a multiple sens?
q_vocab_c2_04_001.correct: It can mean 'bank' (financial institution), 'bench' (seating), or 'school of fish'
wrong: It only means 'bank' (financial institution)
It means 'bank' and 'blanket'
It means 'bench' and 'boat'
q_vocab_c2_04_001.explanation: 'Banco' est a classic Espagnol homonym avec à least three distinct sens: a financial bank, a bench ou seat, et a school de fish (banco de peces). Context determines quel sens applies.

q_vocab_c2_04_002.question: La ___ de Madrid es una ciudad vibrante, pero la ___ extranjera fluctúa constantemente.
wrong: ciudad ... moneda
capital ... cuenta
urbe ... capital
q_vocab_c2_04_002.explanation: 'Capital' est a homonym: 'la capital' (féminin) signifie 'capital city,' pendant que 'el capital' (masculin) signifie 'capital/funds/money.' Les deux blanks use 'capital' mais avec different genders et sens.

q_vocab_c2_04_003.question: Quels sont Le/La different sens de 'muñeca'?
wrong: It means both 'ankle' and 'puppet'
It means both 'finger' and 'doll'
It means both 'wrist' and 'blanket'
q_vocab_c2_04_003.explanation: 'Muñeca' a two primary sens: Le/La wrist (anatomy) et a doll (toy). A troisième colloquial sens dans quelques regions se réfère à a personne's skill ou charm ('tener muñeca').

q_vocab_c2_04_004.question: Que 'cola' signifier dans son various senses?
q_vocab_c2_04_004.correct: tail (of an animal), queue/line (of people), and glue (adhesive)
wrong: only tail and a carbonated drink
only queue and a type of fabric
only glue and a musical instrument
q_vocab_c2_04_004.explanation: 'Cola' a multiple sens: 'tail' (la cola del perro), 'queue' (hacer cola), et 'glue' (cola de pegar). Context est essential à disambiguate Ce highly polysemous mot.

q_vocab_c2_04_005.question: Le/La leaves fall de Le/La trees dans autumn.
q_vocab_c2_04_005.correct: Las hojas caen de los árboles en otoño.
wrong: Las hojas caen de las plantas en invierno.
Las páginas caen de los árboles en otoño.
Las hojas suben de los árboles en otoño.
q_vocab_c2_04_005.explanation: 'Hoja' est a homonym sens les deux 'leaf' (de a tree) et 'sheet/page' (de paper) ou 'blade' (de a knife). Ici, dans Le/La context de autumn et trees, il clearly signifie 'leaf.'

q_vocab_c2_04_006.question: Quels sont Le/La different sens de 'gato'?
q_vocab_c2_04_006.correct: cat (animal), car jack (tool), and a native of Madrid (colloquial)
wrong: cat (animal) and a type of dance
cat (animal) and a cooking utensil
cat (animal) and a card game
q_vocab_c2_04_006.explanation: 'Gato' primarily signifie 'cat,' mais il aussi se réfère à a car jack (gato hidráulico) used à lift vehicles. Colloquially, personnes born dans Madrid sont called 'gatos,' a centuries-vieux nickname.

q_vocab_c2_04_007.question: Someone says 'Voy a operar en la bolsa mañana.' Que do ils signifier?
q_vocab_c2_04_007.correct: They are going to trade on the stock market tomorrow.
wrong: They are going to perform surgery on a bag tomorrow.
They are going to open a purse tomorrow.
They are going to search through a handbag tomorrow.
q_vocab_c2_04_007.explanation: 'Bolsa' signifie 'bag' dans everyday use, mais 'la bolsa' (ou 'la Bolsa de Valores') se réfère à 'Le/La stock market/stock exchange.' 'Operar en la bolsa' est a fixed financial expression sens 'à trade sur Le/La stock market.'
q_vocab_c2_04_007.context: Hearing a colleague talk about their financial plans

q_vocab_c2_04_008.question: Que 'vela' signifier dans son different senses?
q_vocab_c2_04_008.correct: candle, sail (of a boat), and vigil/watch (staying awake)
wrong: only candle and curtain
only sail and ceiling
only vigil and speed
q_vocab_c2_04_008.explanation: 'Vela' a three main sens: a candle (encender una vela), a sail (izar la vela), et a vigil ou wakefulness (noche de vela). Le/La related expression 'estar en vela' signifie 'à être unable à sleep.'

q_vocab_c2_04_009.question: No me dio vela en este entierro.
q_vocab_c2_04_009.correct: Nobody gave me a say in this matter. (It's none of my business.)
wrong: Nobody gave me a candle at this funeral.
Nobody gave me a sail for this journey.
Nobody kept a vigil at this burial.
q_vocab_c2_04_009.explanation: 'No dar vela en un entierro' est an idiomatic expression sens 'à avoir no say/role dans a matter.' Ici 'vela' plays sur son literal sens (candle à a funeral) mais Le/La phrase est entirely figurative, sens someone était not consulted ou involved.

q_vocab_c2_04_010.question: Vous read Le/La phrase: 'El cabo dirigió la operación desde el cabo más meridional de la península.' Comment interpret Le/La two uses de 'cabo'?
q_vocab_c2_04_010.correct: The corporal (military rank) directed the operation from the southernmost cape (geographical feature) of the peninsula.
wrong: The rope directed the operation from the southernmost end of the peninsula.
The captain directed the operation from the southernmost cliff of the peninsula.
The cable directed the operation from the southernmost border of the peninsula.
q_vocab_c2_04_010.explanation: 'Cabo' est a polysemous mot avec several sens: a military rank (corporal), a geographical cape ou headland, a rope/cable, et an end ou stub. Dans Ce phrase, Le/La premier 'cabo' est Le/La military rank et Le/La deuxième est Le/La geographical feature.
q_vocab_c2_04_010.context: Reading a historical text about a military operation

q_vocab_c2_05_001.question: Que 'quijotesco' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_05_001.correct: quixotic (idealistic, impractical, inspired by Don Quixote)
wrong: related to quick movements
characteristic of a quiet person
typical of a medieval knight
q_vocab_c2_05_001.explanation: 'Quijotesco' derives de Don Quijote de la Mancha et décrit someone Qui est idealistically impractical, pursuing lofty mais unrealistic goals. Il a become a standard adjectif en espagnol literary et everyday langue.

q_vocab_c2_05_002.question: Que Le/La expression 'luchar contra molinos de viento' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_05_002.correct: to fight imaginary enemies / to battle against impossible odds
wrong: to work in a flour mill
to travel through the countryside of La Mancha
to compete in a windmill-building contest
q_vocab_c2_05_002.explanation: Ce expression vient de Cervantes' Don Quixote, où Le/La protagonist attacks windmills believing them à être giants. 'Luchar contra molinos de viento' signifie fighting against imaginary ou unbeatable adversaries.

q_vocab_c2_05_003.question: La obra se inspira en el ___ del Siglo de Oro español.
wrong: letrado
litigio
liderazgo
q_vocab_c2_05_003.explanation: 'Legado' signifie 'legacy' ou 'heritage.' Le/La 'Siglo de Oro' (Golden Age, roughly 16th-17th centuries) était Le/La pinnacle de Espagnol arts et literature, producing Cervantes, Lope de Vega, Calderón, et Quevedo.

q_vocab_c2_05_004.question: Que 'celestina' signifier quand used as a commun nom (not a proper name)?
q_vocab_c2_05_004.correct: a go-between or matchmaker (often with negative connotations)
wrong: a celestial or heavenly being
a type of Spanish dessert
a medieval queen
q_vocab_c2_05_004.explanation: 'Celestina' vient de Fernando de Rojas' 'La Celestina' (1499), où Le/La title character est a cunning vieux woman qui arranges secret meetings between lovers. As a commun nom, 'celestina' signifie a meddling matchmaker.

q_vocab_c2_05_005.question: Que 'picaresco' signifier dans Le/La context de Espagnol literature et culture?
q_vocab_c2_05_005.correct: picaresque (relating to a genre featuring a clever, roguish protagonist from a low social class)
wrong: picturesque (visually charming or quaint)
related to bullfighting culture
characteristic of Picasso's artistic style
q_vocab_c2_05_005.explanation: 'Picaresco' se réfère à Le/La picaresque literary genre Cela originated dans 16th-century Spain avec works like 'Lazarillo de Tormes.' Il features a 'pícaro' (rogue) qui survives par wit dans a corrupt society. Le/La genre influenced European literature broadly.

q_vocab_c2_05_006.question: He est a real Sancho Panza: practical, loyal, et down-à-earth.
q_vocab_c2_05_006.correct: Es un verdadero Sancho Panza: práctico, leal y con los pies en la tierra.
wrong: Es un verdadero Don Quijote: práctico, leal y con los pies en la tierra.
Es un verdadero Sancho Panza: idealista, soñador y con la cabeza en las nubes.
Es un verdadero Sancho Panza: práctico, leal y con la cabeza bien alta.
q_vocab_c2_05_006.explanation: Sancho Panza, Don Quixote's squire, represents practical commun sense et earthly wisdom, contrasting avec Don Quixote's idealism. Calling someone a 'Sancho Panza' signifie ils sont realistic, loyal, et pragmatic.

q_vocab_c2_05_007.question: Que 'lazarillo' signifier quand used as a commun nom?
q_vocab_c2_05_007.correct: a guide for a blind person (from 'Lazarillo de Tormes')
wrong: a type of hospital for the sick
a small lizard found in Spain
a young apprentice in a workshop
q_vocab_c2_05_007.explanation: 'Lazarillo' derives de Le/La anonymous 16th-century novel 'Lazarillo de Tormes,' whose young protagonist serves as a guide à a blind man. Le/La mot became a commun nom sens 'guide pour a blind personne' (perro lazarillo = guide dog).

q_vocab_c2_05_008.question: Esa decisión fue un auténtico auto de fe político.
q_vocab_c2_05_008.correct: That decision was a genuine political act of faith (public condemnation/trial).
wrong: That decision was a genuine political autobiography.
That decision was a genuine political self-sacrifice.
That decision was a genuine political car accident.
q_vocab_c2_05_008.explanation: 'Auto de fe' historically referred à Le/La public ceremony de Le/La Espagnol Inquisition où sentences étaient pronounced. Metaphorically, il décrit n'importe quel dramatic public condemnation ou ideological purge. Il carries strong historical et cultural weight.

q_vocab_c2_05_009.question: Vous sont describing someone qui constantly exaggerates et embellishes stories. Quel culturally loaded Espagnol expression fits best?
wrong: Es un buen hidalgo.
Es un buen conquistador.
Es un buen torero.
q_vocab_c2_05_009.explanation: A 'juglar' était a medieval minstrel qui told stories, sang, et entertained, souvent embellishing tales pour dramatic effect. Calling someone 'un buen juglar' playfully suggests ils sont a skilled mais exaggerative storyteller. 'Hidalgo' se réfère à minor nobility, 'conquistador' à explorers, et 'torero' à bullfighters.
q_vocab_c2_05_009.context: Describing a friend's tendency to embellish stories

q_vocab_c2_05_010.question: A Espagnol speaker says 'Esto es una leyenda negra.' Dans que context est Ce cultural allusion typiquement used?
q_vocab_c2_05_010.correct: To describe an unfairly negative historical reputation, especially regarding Spain's colonial past
wrong: To describe a famous ghost story from Spanish folklore
To refer to a dark-themed literary novel
To describe a very popular urban legend
q_vocab_c2_05_010.explanation: 'Leyenda negra' (Black Legend) est a historiographical concept referring à Le/La anti-Espagnol propaganda Cela exaggerated Le/La cruelty de Le/La Espagnol Empire. Today, 'leyenda negra' est utilisé more broadly pour décrire n'importe quel unfairly negative narrative à propos de a personne, institution, ou country.
q_vocab_c2_05_010.context: A debate about historical narratives and national reputations

q_vocab_c2_06_001.question: Que 'no tener pelos en la lengua' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_06_001.correct: to be outspoken / to not mince words
wrong: to have a speech impediment
to be unable to taste food
to keep a secret very well
q_vocab_c2_06_001.explanation: 'No tener pelos en la lengua' literally signifie 'à not avoir hairs sur one's tongue.' Il décrit someone qui speaks frankly et directly sans holding back, même si Le/La truth est uncomfortable.

q_vocab_c2_06_002.question: Después de mucho esfuerzo, por fin dimos en el ___.
wrong: blanco
punto
centro
q_vocab_c2_06_002.explanation: 'Dar en el clavo' signifie 'à hit Le/La nail sur Le/La head,' i.e., à get something exactly right. Le/La phrase says 'Après beaucoup effort, we finally hit Le/La nail sur Le/La head.' Note: 'dar en el blanco' (hit Le/La target) est a different idiom.

q_vocab_c2_06_003.question: Que 'estar en las nubes' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_06_003.correct: to be daydreaming / to have one's head in the clouds
wrong: to be extremely happy
to be flying on an airplane
to be very tall
q_vocab_c2_06_003.explanation: 'Estar en las nubes' signifie à être distracted, absent-minded, ou lost dans thought. Il est equivalent à Le/La Anglais 'à avoir one's head dans Le/La clouds.'

q_vocab_c2_06_004.question: Que 'meter la pata' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_06_004.correct: to put one's foot in it / to make a blunder
wrong: to kick someone
to walk with difficulty
to step on something accidentally
q_vocab_c2_06_004.explanation: 'Meter la pata' (literally 'à put Le/La paw dans') signifie pour faire an embarrassing mistake ou blunder, surtout par saying something inappropriate. Il est equivalent à 'à put one's foot dans one's mouth.'

q_vocab_c2_06_005.question: He promised à help me, mais dans Le/La end he left me high et dry.
q_vocab_c2_06_005.correct: Prometió ayudarme, pero al final me dejó en la estacada.
wrong: Prometió ayudarme, pero al final me dejó en la calle.
Prometió ayudarme, pero al final me dejó en la luna.
Prometió ayudarme, pero al final me dejó en las nubes.
q_vocab_c2_06_005.explanation: 'Dejar en la estacada' signifie 'à leave someone dans Le/La lurch' ou 'à abandon someone dans a difficult situation.' Il originates de medieval jousting, où Le/La 'estacada' était Le/La fenced arena.

q_vocab_c2_06_006.question: Que 'no dar pie con bola' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_06_006.correct: to not get anything right / to be completely off the mark
wrong: to not be able to walk properly
to not play football well
to not have enough money for a ball
q_vocab_c2_06_006.explanation: 'No dar pie con bola' signifie à être unable à do anything right, à fail à everything one attempts. Il likely vient de ball games où Le/La player ne peut pas even kick Le/La ball correctly.

q_vocab_c2_06_007.question: Votre boss asks comment Le/La project est going. Everything est under control et progressing smoothly. Quel idiom best décrit Le/La situation?
wrong: Todo está patas arriba.
Todo está manga por hombro.
Todo está en el aire.
q_vocab_c2_06_007.explanation: 'Ir viento en popa' (literally 'wind à Le/La stern') signifie everything est going très well, avec favorable conditions. 'Patas arriba' et 'manga por hombro' les deux signifier things sont dans disorder, et 'en el aire' signifie uncertain.
q_vocab_c2_06_007.context: Reporting on a project's progress to a supervisor

q_vocab_c2_06_008.question: Que 'tirar la casa por la ventana' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_06_008.correct: to spare no expense / to go all out (spending lavishly)
wrong: to throw everything away in anger
to renovate a house completely
to move out of a house suddenly
q_vocab_c2_06_008.explanation: 'Tirar la casa por la ventana' (literally 'à throw Le/La house out Le/La window') signifie à spend extravagantly, sparing no expense pour a celebration ou event. Son origin est tied à lottery winners qui serait throw belongings out Le/La window dans celebration.

q_vocab_c2_06_009.question: A buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan.
q_vocab_c2_06_009.correct: A word to the wise is sufficient.
wrong: Good speakers use few words.
A good listener always stays silent.
Short sentences make better writing.
q_vocab_c2_06_009.explanation: Ce classic Espagnol proverb signifie Cela an intelligent personne needs seulement a brief hint à understand a message. Il est equivalent à 'a mot à Le/La wise est sufficient' ou 'verbum sapienti sat est.'

q_vocab_c2_06_010.question: A colleague est being overly cautious à propos de a minor risk. Vous want à tell them ils sont making a mountain out de a molehill. Quel expression fits?
q_vocab_c2_06_010.correct: Estás haciendo una montaña de un grano de arena.
wrong: Estás buscando tres pies al gato.
Estás dando palos de ciego.
Estás echando leña al fuego.
q_vocab_c2_06_010.explanation: 'Hacer una montaña de un grano de arena' (pour faire a mountain out de a grain de sand) signifie à exaggerate a minor problem. 'Buscar tres pies al gato' signifie à overcomplicate things, 'dar palos de ciego' signifie à act blindly, et 'echar leña al fuego' signifie à add fuel à Le/La fire.
q_vocab_c2_06_010.context: A colleague worrying excessively about a small issue

q_vocab_c2_07_001.question: Que 'fallecer' signifier, et que register does il belong à?
q_vocab_c2_07_001.correct: to pass away / to die (formal/euphemistic register)
wrong: to fail an exam (academic register)
to faint or lose consciousness (medical register)
to fall down (neutral register)
q_vocab_c2_07_001.explanation: 'Fallecer' est Le/La formel ou euphemistic way pour dire 'à die' en espagnol. Le/La neutral term est 'morir,' pendant que colloquial/vulgar variants include 'palmar,' 'estirar la pata,' ou 'quedarse tieso.' Knowing register differences est essential à C2.

q_vocab_c2_07_002.question: Que 'palmar' signifier dans colloquial Espagnol?
q_vocab_c2_07_002.correct: to die / to kick the bucket (very informal/slang)
wrong: to clap one's hands in applause
to touch a palm tree
to win a prize or award
q_vocab_c2_07_002.explanation: 'Palmar' est très colloquial slang pour 'à die,' similaire à Anglais 'à kick Le/La bucket' ou 'à croak.' Using il dans a formel context serait highly inappropriate. Le/La formel equivalent est 'fallecer' et Le/La neutral term est 'morir.'

q_vocab_c2_07_003.question: El detenido fue ___ a la comisaría para prestar declaración.
wrong: llevado
arrastrado
traído
q_vocab_c2_07_003.explanation: 'Conducido' (formel: 'escorted/taken') est Le/La appropriate register pour police et legal reports. Pendant que 'llevado' (taken) est neutral, official documents use 'conducido' pour transporting detainees. Ce register distinction est critical dans legal et administrative Espagnol.

q_vocab_c2_07_004.question: Quel est Le/La formel equivalent de 'comer' dans elevated written style?
wrong: zampar (to wolf down)
jamar (to scoff down)
tragar (to swallow)
q_vocab_c2_07_004.explanation: 'Ingerir alimentos' est Le/La formel/technical way pour exprimer eating, used dans medical, scientific, et legal contexts. 'Zampar' et 'jamar' sont colloquial/slang, pendant que 'tragar' (à swallow) est neutral mais less refined than 'ingerir.'

q_vocab_c2_07_005.question: Que 'ebrio' signifier, et comment does il differ dans register de son synonyms?
q_vocab_c2_07_005.correct: drunk (formal/literary); neutral is 'borracho,' colloquial is 'pedo' or 'mamado'
wrong: angry (formal); neutral is 'enfadado,' colloquial is 'cabreado'
tired (formal); neutral is 'cansado,' colloquial is 'reventado'
sick (formal); neutral is 'enfermo,' colloquial is 'pachucho'
q_vocab_c2_07_005.explanation: 'Ebrio' est Le/La formel ou literary term pour 'drunk,' used dans legal reports, literature, et formel writing. 'Borracho' est Le/La standard neutral term. Colloquial variants include 'pedo,' 'mamado,' 'como una cuba,' depending sur Le/La region.

q_vocab_c2_07_006.question: She reprimanded her subordinate pour Le/La repeated errors.
q_vocab_c2_07_006.correct: Amonestó a su subordinado por los errores reiterados.
wrong: Echó una bronca a su subordinado por los errores reiterados.
Riñó a su subordinado por los errores reiterados.
Regañó a su subordinado por los errores reiterados.
q_vocab_c2_07_006.explanation: 'Amonestar' est Le/La formel term pour 'à reprimand,' used dans administrative et legal contexts. 'Echar una bronca' est colloquial, 'reñir' est informel, et 'regañar' est neutral/slightly informel. C2 mastery requires selecting Le/La appropriate register.

q_vocab_c2_07_007.question: Que 'domicilio' signifier, et comment does il differ de son informel equivalents?
wrong: neighborhood (formal); informal equivalents are 'barrio' or 'zona'
building (formal); informal equivalents are 'bloque' or 'edificio'
city (formal); informal equivalents are 'pueblo' or 'urbe'
q_vocab_c2_07_007.explanation: 'Domicilio' est Le/La formel/legal term pour one's place de residence, used sur official documents, legal proceedings, et formel correspondence. Dans everyday speech, personnes say 'mi casa' ou 'mi piso.' Le/La phrase 'a domicilio' signifie 'à one's home' (e.g., 'entrega a domicilio' = home delivery).

q_vocab_c2_07_008.question: La empresa procedió a ___ al empleado tras el incidente.
q_vocab_c2_07_008.correct: The company proceeded to dismiss the employee after the incident.
wrong: The company proceeded to promote the employee after the incident.
The company proceeded to hire the employee after the incident.
The company proceeded to transfer the employee after the incident.
q_vocab_c2_07_008.explanation: 'Prescindir de' ou 'despedir' (à dismiss) serait fill Le/La blank dans formel register. Le/La formel phrasing 'procedió a' suivi de a formel verbe est characteristic de corporate et legal communication, contrasting avec colloquial 'echar' (à fire/throw out).

q_vocab_c2_07_009.question: Vous sont writing a formel complaint letter. Vous want pour exprimer Cela vous sont unhappy. Quel phrasing est la plupart appropriate pour Le/La register?
q_vocab_c2_07_009.correct: Me dirijo a ustedes para manifestar mi disconformidad.
wrong: Les escribo porque estoy muy enfadado.
Oigan, no estoy nada contento con esto.
Quiero quejarme porque me parece fatal.
q_vocab_c2_07_009.explanation: 'Manifestar mi disconformidad' (pour exprimer my dissatisfaction) est Le/La formel register appropriate pour official complaints. 'Me dirijo a ustedes' est Le/La standard formel opening. Le/La other options sont progressively more informel et inappropriate pour a written complaint.
q_vocab_c2_07_009.context: Drafting a formal complaint letter to a company

q_vocab_c2_07_010.question: A ami tells vous excitedly à propos de leur nouveau job. Vous want pour dire 'Congratulations!' dans Le/La la plupart informel, celebratory way. Quel option fits?
wrong: Le felicito cordialmente por su nuevo puesto.
Permítame expresarle mis más sinceras felicitaciones.
Reciba usted mi más cordial enhorabuena.
q_vocab_c2_07_010.explanation: '¡Tío, qué pasada!' est très informel Espagnol slang (Spain) expressing excitement. 'Enhorabuena' est Le/La standard congratulations. Le/La other options sont progressively more formel: appropriate pour professional ou written contexts, mais stilted among close friends.
q_vocab_c2_07_010.context: A close friend sharing exciting personal news

q_vocab_c2_08_001.question: Que 'postular' signifier dans academic discourse?
q_vocab_c2_08_001.correct: to postulate / to propose (a theory or hypothesis)
wrong: to postpone a deadline
to post a letter
to position oneself physically
q_vocab_c2_08_001.explanation: 'Postular' signifie à put forward a theory, hypothesis, ou principle pour consideration. Dans academic et scientific writing, il est a formel way à introduce a claim ou proposition Cela sera être examined.

q_vocab_c2_08_002.question: El objetivo de este ensayo es ___ las causas subyacentes del fenómeno.
wrong: dilatar
diluir
divulgar
q_vocab_c2_08_002.explanation: 'Dilucidar' signifie 'à elucidate' ou 'à clarify,' used dans formel et academic writing à signifier making something clear through analysis. 'Dilatar' signifie à delay, 'diluir' signifie à dilute, et 'divulgar' signifie à disseminate.

q_vocab_c2_08_003.question: Que 'rebatir' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_08_003.correct: to refute / to counter an argument
wrong: to repeat a statement
to rebuild a structure
to reconsider a position
q_vocab_c2_08_003.explanation: 'Rebatir' signifie à argue against ou refute a point, offering counter-evidence ou counter-arguments. Il est a key verbe dans academic debate et critical writing.

q_vocab_c2_08_004.question: Que 'corroborar' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_08_004.correct: to corroborate / to confirm with supporting evidence
wrong: to collaborate on a project
to correct a mistake
to correlate two variables
q_vocab_c2_08_004.explanation: 'Corroborar' signifie à strengthen ou confirm a claim par providing additional evidence ou testimony. Il est essential dans academic, legal, et journalistic discourse.

q_vocab_c2_08_005.question: Le/La results de Le/La study undermine Le/La previously accepted theory.
q_vocab_c2_08_005.correct: Los resultados del estudio socavan la teoría previamente aceptada.
wrong: Los resultados del estudio refuerzan la teoría previamente aceptada.
Los resultados del estudio socavan la hipótesis recientemente propuesta.
Los resultados del estudio ignoran la teoría previamente aceptada.
q_vocab_c2_08_005.explanation: 'Socavar' signifie 'à undermine' (literally 'à dig under'). Dans academic discourse, il décrit evidence ou arguments Cela weaken ou erode an established position.

q_vocab_c2_08_006.question: Que 'soslayar' signifier dans formel discourse?
q_vocab_c2_08_006.correct: to sidestep / to avoid addressing (an issue or difficulty)
wrong: to solve a problem directly
to support a colleague's argument
to summarize a lengthy discussion
q_vocab_c2_08_006.explanation: 'Soslayar' signifie à dodge, sidestep, ou deliberately avoid confronting an issue. Dans academic et political discourse, accusing someone de 'soslayar' a topic implies ils sont evading an important matter.

q_vocab_c2_08_007.question: A reviewer writes: 'El autor no logra fundamentar su argumento principal.' Quel est Le/La reviewer criticizing?
q_vocab_c2_08_007.correct: The author fails to provide sufficient evidence or grounding for the main argument.
wrong: The author fails to present the main argument clearly.
The author fails to cite other scholars in the field.
The author fails to organize the paper logically.
q_vocab_c2_08_007.explanation: 'Fundamentar' signifie 'à substantiate' ou 'à provide a foundation pour.' Le/La reviewer est saying Le/La author's central claim lacks adequate supporting evidence ou reasoning, not Cela il est unclear ou poorly organized.
q_vocab_c2_08_007.context: Reading a peer review of an academic paper

q_vocab_c2_08_008.question: Que 'acotar' signifier dans academic et editorial contexts?
q_vocab_c2_08_008.correct: to delimit / to annotate / to narrow the scope of a discussion
wrong: to accept a proposal without reservation
to accumulate evidence gradually
to accelerate the pace of research
q_vocab_c2_08_008.explanation: 'Acotar' a several related sens: à set boundaries (acotar un tema = à delimit a topic), à annotate a text avec marginal notes, ou à quote/cite. Dans academic writing, 'acotar el alcance' signifie à narrow Le/La scope de an investigation.

q_vocab_c2_08_009.question: Cabe señalar que los hallazgos preliminares no son concluyentes.
q_vocab_c2_08_009.correct: It should be noted that the preliminary findings are not conclusive.
wrong: It should be noted that the final findings are not complete.
It is worth mentioning that the preliminary methods are not conclusive.
It should be emphasized that the preliminary findings are definitive.
q_vocab_c2_08_009.explanation: 'Cabe señalar' est a formel discourse marker sens 'il devrait être noted' ou 'il est worth pointing out.' 'Hallazgos' signifie 'findings,' et 'concluyentes' signifie 'conclusive.' C'est typical academic hedging langue.

q_vocab_c2_08_010.question: Vous sont moderating an academic debate. One speaker a made a strong claim. Vous want à invite Le/La other panelist à respond. Quel formel expression est la plupart appropriate?
q_vocab_c2_08_010.correct: ¿Desea rebatir o matizar la afirmación de su colega?
wrong: ¿Quiere decir que su colega está equivocado?
¿Tiene algo que decir sobre lo que ha dicho?
¿Está de acuerdo o no con lo que acaba de oír?
q_vocab_c2_08_010.explanation: 'Rebatir' (à refute) et 'matizar' (à qualify/nuance) sont key academic discourse verbes. Offering les deux options est diplomatic: Le/La panelist peut l'un ou l'autre challenge Le/La claim outright ou offer a more nuanced response. Ce phrasing est appropriately formel pour a moderated debate.
q_vocab_c2_08_010.context: Moderating a formal academic panel discussion

q_vocab_c2_09_001.question: Que 'ojalá' signifier, et Quel est son etymological origin?
q_vocab_c2_09_001.correct: It means 'hopefully / I wish' and comes from Arabic 'inshallah' (God willing)
wrong: It means 'look out' and comes from Latin 'oculare'
It means 'goodbye' and comes from French 'au revoir'
It means 'enjoy' and comes from Greek 'hēdonē'
q_vocab_c2_09_001.explanation: 'Ojalá' derives de Le/La Arabic expression 'inshā'Allāh' (law shā' Allāh), sens 'God willing.' Il entered Espagnol pendant Le/La centuries de Moorish presence dans Le/La Iberian Peninsula. Today il signifie 'hopefully' ou 'I wish' et est suivi de Le/La subjonctif.

q_vocab_c2_09_002.question: Que 'alcalde' signifier, et que langue does il originate de?
q_vocab_c2_09_002.correct: It means 'mayor' and comes from Arabic 'al-qāḍī' (the judge)
wrong: It means 'castle' and comes from Latin 'castellum'
It means 'mayor' and comes from French 'maire'
It means 'governor' and comes from Gothic 'waldand'
q_vocab_c2_09_002.explanation: 'Alcalde' (mayor) derives de Arabic 'al-qāḍī,' sens 'Le/La judge.' Beaucoup Espagnol mots beginning avec 'al-' viennent de Arabic, reflecting Le/La nearly 800 years de Moorish règle dans Le/La Iberian Peninsula.

q_vocab_c2_09_003.question: La palabra 'almohada' proviene del árabe 'al-mujadda,' que significa ___.
wrong: almacén
alfombra
almendra
q_vocab_c2_09_003.explanation: 'Almohada' (pillow) vient de Arabic 'al-mujadda,' derived de 'khadd' sens 'cheek' (mejilla), puisque a pillow est où one rests one's cheek. Ceci est un prime exemple de comment Arabic etymologies reveal Le/La original semantic logic behind Espagnol mots.

q_vocab_c2_09_004.question: Que Le/La Latin root 'duc-/duct-' contribute à Espagnol mots?
q_vocab_c2_09_004.correct: It means 'to lead/guide' and appears in conducir, educación, deducir, producir
wrong: It means 'to build' and appears in estructura, construcción
It means 'to speak' and appears in discurso, elocuencia
It means 'to write' and appears in escritura, descripción
q_vocab_c2_09_004.explanation: Le/La Latin root 'ducere' (à lead) est one de Le/La la plupart productive en espagnol. Il gives rise à 'conducir' (à drive/lead), 'educación' (leading out/education), 'deducir' (à deduce), 'producir' (à produce), 'reducir' (à reduce), et beaucoup more.

q_vocab_c2_09_005.question: Que Le/La prefix 'des-' indiquer dans mots like 'deshacer,' 'desconfianza,' et 'desequilibrio'?
q_vocab_c2_09_005.correct: reversal, removal, or negation of the base word's meaning
wrong: intensification or emphasis of the base word's meaning
repetition or duplication of the base word's action
completion or fulfillment of the base word's process
q_vocab_c2_09_005.explanation: Le/La prefix 'des-' (de Latin 'dis-') indique reversal ou negation: 'deshacer' (à undo), 'desconfianza' (distrust), 'desequilibrio' (imbalance). Il est one de Le/La la plupart productive prefixes en espagnol mot formation.

q_vocab_c2_09_006.question: Le/La mot 'guitar' en anglais vient de Le/La Espagnol 'guitarra.'
q_vocab_c2_09_006.correct: La palabra 'guitar' en inglés proviene del español 'guitarra.'
wrong: La palabra 'guitar' en inglés proviene del francés 'guitare.'
La palabra 'guitar' en inglés proviene del italiano 'chitarra.'
La palabra 'guitar' en inglés proviene del portugués 'guitarra.'
q_vocab_c2_09_006.explanation: Anglais 'guitar' vient de Espagnol 'guitarra,' quel dans turn derives de Arabic 'qītāra,' itself de Greek 'kithára.' Ce chain de borrowing illustrates Le/La rich etymological layering de Espagnol vocabulary.

q_vocab_c2_09_007.question: Que 'guadal-' signifier en espagnol place names like 'Guadalquivir' et 'Guadalajara'?
q_vocab_c2_09_007.correct: river or valley (from Arabic 'wādī' meaning river/valley)
wrong: mountain or peak (from Arabic 'jabal' meaning mountain)
castle or fortress (from Arabic 'qal'a' meaning fortress)
garden or orchard (from Arabic 'bustān' meaning garden)
q_vocab_c2_09_007.explanation: 'Guadal-' vient de Arabic 'wādī' (river/valley). 'Guadalquivir' signifie 'Le/La great river' (wādī al-kabīr), et 'Guadalajara' signifie 'river de stones' (wādī al-ḥijāra). Espagnol toponymy preserves extensive Arabic influence.

q_vocab_c2_09_008.question: La palabra 'azúcar' tiene origen sánscrito, pasó al árabe como 'sukkar' y luego al español.
q_vocab_c2_09_008.correct: The word 'azúcar' has Sanskrit origins, passed into Arabic as 'sukkar,' and then into Spanish.
wrong: The word 'azúcar' has Greek origins, passed into Latin as 'sucrum,' and then into Spanish.
The word 'azúcar' has Arabic origins, passed into Portuguese as 'açúcar,' and then into Spanish.
The word 'azúcar' has Sanskrit origins, passed into Persian as 'shakar,' and then directly into Spanish.
q_vocab_c2_09_008.explanation: 'Azúcar' (sugar) traces back à Sanskrit 'śárkarā,' quel became 'sukkar' dans Arabic (avec Le/La Arabic article 'al-' giving Le/La initial 'a-'), et alors entered Espagnol. Ce etymology spans multiple langue families across millennia.

q_vocab_c2_09_009.question: Vous sont explaining pourquoi donc beaucoup Espagnol mots begin avec 'al-' (like almacén, alfombra, algodón). Quel est Le/La la plupart accurate explanation?
q_vocab_c2_09_009.correct: They are Arabic loanwords; 'al-' is the Arabic definite article absorbed into the Spanish word.
wrong: They are Latin words that evolved a vowel prefix in Vulgar Latin.
They are Basque-origin words that begin with the Basque article.
They are Greek words that entered Spanish through medieval translations.
q_vocab_c2_09_009.explanation: Mots like 'almacén' (warehouse, de al-majzan), 'alfombra' (carpet, de al-ḥanbarīya), et 'algodón' (cotton, de al-quṭun) retain Le/La Arabic article défini 'al-' as an integral part de Le/La Espagnol mot. Sur 4,000 Espagnol mots avoir Arabic origins.
q_vocab_c2_09_009.context: Teaching a class about the Arabic influence on Spanish vocabulary

q_vocab_c2_09_010.question: A student asks vous pourquoi 'haber' (à avoir, auxiliary) et 'tener' (à avoir, possession) sont two different verbes en espagnol quand Anglais uses just one. Quel est Le/La etymological explanation?
q_vocab_c2_09_010.correct: Both come from Latin: 'habēre' became the auxiliary 'haber,' while 'tenēre' (to hold) took over the possessive meaning.
wrong: 'Haber' comes from Germanic and 'tener' comes from Latin.
'Haber' was borrowed from French and 'tener' is native Spanish.
'Haber' comes from Arabic and 'tener' comes from Latin.
q_vocab_c2_09_010.explanation: Dans Latin, 'habēre' meant les deux 'à avoir' et 'à hold.' Dans Le/La evolution à Espagnol, 'habēre' était grammaticalized into Le/La auxiliary verbe 'haber' (used dans compound tenses like 'he comido'), pendant que 'tenēre' (originally 'à hold') expanded à cover Le/La possessive sens de 'à avoir.'
q_vocab_c2_09_010.context: A linguistics class discussing the historical development of Spanish verbs

q_vocab_c2_10_001.question: Que 'ya veremos' typiquement imply pragmatically?
q_vocab_c2_10_001.correct: polite skepticism or non-committal response (we'll see / maybe not)
wrong: enthusiastic agreement (definitely yes!)
a firm promise to follow through
an urgent request for an immediate answer
q_vocab_c2_10_001.explanation: 'Ya veremos' (we'll see) est pragmatically used à politely defer ou exprimer doubt sans directly refusing. Pendant que literally sens 'we sera see,' il souvent implies reluctance ou Cela Le/La speaker est unlikely à agree.

q_vocab_c2_10_002.question: No es por nada, pero ___ que deberías reconsiderar tu decisión.
wrong: sé
digo
insisto
q_vocab_c2_10_002.explanation: 'No es por nada, pero creo que...' est a hedging expression used à soften a potentially unwelcome opinion. 'No es por nada' (il's not pour nothing / no offense mais) est a pragmatic mitigator Cela prepares Le/La listener pour a critical ou unsolicited remark.

q_vocab_c2_10_003.question: Que 'que yo sepa' signifier pragmatically?
q_vocab_c2_10_003.correct: as far as I know (hedging to signal uncertainty or limited knowledge)
wrong: I know for certain (expressing strong confidence)
I want to know (requesting information)
now I know (expressing sudden realization)
q_vocab_c2_10_003.explanation: 'Que yo sepa' (as far as I know) est a pragmatic hedge Cela limits Le/La speaker's commitment à Le/La truth de a statement. Il signals Cela Le/La information pourrait être incomplete ou Cela Le/La speaker est open à correction.

q_vocab_c2_10_004.question: Que 'hombre' signifier quand used as an interjection dans conversation?
q_vocab_c2_10_004.correct: an informal discourse marker expressing surprise, emphasis, or friendly disagreement
wrong: a literal reference to a male person in the conversation
a formal way to address a gentleman
an insult directed at the listener
q_vocab_c2_10_004.explanation: Quand used as an interjection, '¡Hombre!' (ou '¡Mujer!' à a woman) functions as a discourse marker. Il peut exprimer surprise ('¡Hombre, no sabía!'), friendly protest ('¡Hombre, no exageres!'), ou warmth ('¡Hombre, cuánto tiempo!'). Il a no literal genre sens dans Ce usage.

q_vocab_c2_10_005.question: Si someone says 'I serait like à politely decline Le/La invitation,' comment do ils say il en espagnol?
q_vocab_c2_10_005.correct: Me encantaría, pero me resulta imposible asistir.
wrong: No quiero ir.
No me da la gana de ir.
Paso de ir a eso.
q_vocab_c2_10_005.explanation: 'Me encantaría, pero me resulta imposible' (I serait love à, mais il's impossible pour me) est a poli refusal strategy. Il softens Le/La 'no' par premier expressing desire, alors giving an indirect reason. Le/La other options range de blunt à rude.

q_vocab_c2_10_006.question: Que 'por si acaso' exprimer pragmatically?
wrong: by chance (expressing luck)
because of that (expressing cause)
in that case (expressing a condition)
q_vocab_c2_10_006.explanation: 'Por si acaso' signifie 'just dans case' et est utilisé as a pragmatic hedge à justify a precautionary action. Il softens Le/La implication Cela something mauvais pourrait happen: 'Lleva un paraguas, por si acaso' (Take an umbrella, just dans case).

q_vocab_c2_10_007.question: A Espagnol speaker says 'Bueno, es que...' à Le/La start de leur response. Que pragmatic function does Ce serve?
q_vocab_c2_10_007.correct: It introduces an excuse, explanation, or a polite way to disagree or decline.
wrong: It indicates enthusiastic agreement with what was said.
It signals that the speaker is about to change the subject entirely.
It marks the beginning of a formal speech or presentation.
q_vocab_c2_10_007.explanation: 'Bueno, es que...' est a pragmatic formula used à introduce an explanation, justification, ou softened disagreement. 'Bueno' serves as a discourse marker, et 'es que' provides a mitigating preface pour que pourrait être an uncomfortable response.
q_vocab_c2_10_007.context: A conversation where someone is asked to do a favor

q_vocab_c2_10_008.question: Que 'no sé si me explico' signifier pragmatically dans conversation?
q_vocab_c2_10_008.correct: I don't know if I'm making myself clear (a self-checking hedge for clarity)
wrong: I don't know if I should explain (expressing reluctance)
I can't explain this topic (expressing inability)
I don't know the explanation (expressing ignorance)
q_vocab_c2_10_008.explanation: 'No sé si me explico' est a pragmatic self-checking device Cela invites Le/La listener à confirm understanding. Il signals Le/La speaker's awareness Cela leur point may être complex et montre openness à rephrasing si needed.

q_vocab_c2_10_009.question: Perdona que te moleste, pero ¿te importaría bajar un poco la música?
q_vocab_c2_10_009.correct: Sorry to bother you, but would you mind turning the music down a bit?
wrong: Sorry to bother you, but could you turn off the music completely?
Sorry to disturb you, but please stop the noise immediately.
I'm sorry, but you must lower the music right now.
q_vocab_c2_10_009.explanation: 'Perdona que te moleste' + '¿te importaría...?' est a doubly hedged request: Le/La speaker premier apologizes pour Le/La imposition, alors uses a conditionnel question pour faire Le/La request indirect. 'Un poco' (a bit) further softens Le/La demand.

q_vocab_c2_10_010.question: Vous disagree avec a colleague's proposal dans a meeting mais want pour exprimer Ce diplomatically. Quel formulation demonstrates Le/La highest level de pragmatic competence?
q_vocab_c2_10_010.correct: Entiendo tu punto de vista, pero me pregunto si no convendría considerar otra alternativa.
wrong: No estoy de acuerdo contigo. Mi propuesta es mejor.
Creo que estás equivocado y deberías cambiar de opinión.
Tu propuesta no tiene sentido. Hay que buscar otra solución.
q_vocab_c2_10_010.explanation: 'Entiendo tu punto de vista' (I understand votre perspective) validates Le/La other personne premier. 'Me pregunto si...' (I wonder si...) introduces Le/La disagreement as a question rather than a statement. 'No convendría' (wouldn't il être advisable) uses negative interrogative à suggest an alternative sans direct confrontation.
q_vocab_c2_10_010.context: A professional meeting where you disagree with a colleague's proposal

q_vocab_c2_11_001.question: Que 'tuitear' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_11_001.correct: to tweet (to post a message on Twitter/X)
wrong: to tutor someone online
to play a musical instrument
to whistle a tune
q_vocab_c2_11_001.explanation: 'Tuitear' est a neologism adapted de Anglais 'à tweet.' Il follows Espagnol verbe formation rules (-ear suffix). Related mots include 'tuit' (a tweet) et 'tuitero/a' (a Twitter user). Le/La RAE acknowledged son use.

q_vocab_c2_11_002.question: Que 'wasapear' signifier?
wrong: to wash something quickly
to wave goodbye to someone
to watch a video online
q_vocab_c2_11_002.explanation: 'Wasapear' (aussi spelled 'guasapear') est an informel verbe sens 'à send a WhatsApp message.' Il demonstrates comment Espagnol adapts foreign brand names into verbes using Le/La -ear conjugation pattern, similaire à 'googlear' (à Google).

q_vocab_c2_11_003.question: Necesito ___ el sistema porque se ha quedado colgado.
wrong: respetar
recetar
reciclar
q_vocab_c2_11_003.explanation: 'Resetear' (à reset) est adapted de Anglais 'reset' avec Le/La Espagnol -ear verbe terminaison. Il est widely used dans technology contexts. Le/La phrase signifie 'I need à reset Le/La system parce que il a frozen.' More formel alternatives include 'reiniciar' ou 'restablecer.'

q_vocab_c2_11_004.question: Que 'bróker' signifier en espagnol?
wrong: a type of bread roll
a broken machine
a brochure or pamphlet
q_vocab_c2_11_004.explanation: 'Bróker' est a Espagnol adaptation de Anglais 'broker,' referring à a financial intermediary. Le/La RAE a accepted Le/La adapted spelling avec an accent mark. Il est utilisé dans finance, insurance, et real estate.

q_vocab_c2_11_005.question: Que 'posverdad' signifier, et comment était il formed?
q_vocab_c2_11_005.correct: post-truth; a calque from English 'post-truth,' combining 'pos-' (post) + 'verdad' (truth)
wrong: positive truth; combining 'positiva' + 'verdad'
possible truth; combining 'posible' + 'verdad'
after the verdict; combining 'pos-' + 'veredicto'
q_vocab_c2_11_005.explanation: 'Posverdad' est a calque (loan translation) de 'post-truth,' describing a cultural situation où objective facts sont less influential than emotional appeals. Le/La RAE recommended Le/La adapted form 'posverdad' sur Le/La Anglais original.

q_vocab_c2_11_006.question: She est an influencer avec millions de followers sur social media.
q_vocab_c2_11_006.correct: Es una influencer con millones de seguidores en las redes sociales.
wrong: Es una influyente con millones de seguidores en las redes sociales.
Es una influenciadora con millones de seguidores en el internet.
Es una influencer con millones de amigos en las redes sociales.
q_vocab_c2_11_006.explanation: Pendant que 'influenciador/a' exists as a Espagnol adaptation, 'influencer' (Le/La Anglais loanword) est widely used et accepted dans everyday Espagnol. 'Seguidores' (followers) et 'redes sociales' (social media/networks) sont established terms.

q_vocab_c2_11_007.question: Que 'trolear' signifier dans internet culture?
q_vocab_c2_11_007.correct: to troll (to deliberately provoke others online)
wrong: to scroll through a website
to translate content online
to troubleshoot a technical problem
q_vocab_c2_11_007.explanation: 'Trolear' (de Anglais 'à troll') signifie à deliberately post provocative ou offensive content online à elicit angry reactions. Related terms include 'trol' (a troll) et 'troleo' (Le/La act de trolling). Il est part de Le/La growing digital Espagnol vocabulary.

q_vocab_c2_11_008.question: Hicimos una videollamada para coordinar el teletrabajo.
q_vocab_c2_11_008.correct: We made a video call to coordinate the remote work.
wrong: We made a phone call to coordinate the office work.
We watched a video to learn about teleworking.
We made a video call to cancel the remote work.
q_vocab_c2_11_008.explanation: 'Videollamada' (video call) et 'teletrabajo' (remote work/telework) sont neologisms Cela became mainstream pendant Le/La COVID-19 pandemic. Les deux sont formed through standard Espagnol mot composition (video + llamada, tele + trabajo).

q_vocab_c2_11_009.question: Vous want pour décrire content Cela a spread rapidly across Le/La internet. Quel Espagnol neologism est appropriate?
wrong: Se ha hecho virtual.
Se ha hecho visual.
Se ha hecho vital.
q_vocab_c2_11_009.explanation: 'Hacerse viral' (à go viral) est a semantic extension où 'viral' (originally a medical term) acquired Le/La sens de rapid, widespread online sharing. Ce metaphorical usage est maintenant standard en espagnol media et everyday langue.
q_vocab_c2_11_009.context: Discussing a trending topic on social media

q_vocab_c2_11_010.question: A langue purist criticizes Le/La use de 'email' en espagnol. Ils argue a Espagnol alternative devrait être used. Quel term do ils likely prefer?
wrong: emilio
e-correo
carta digital
q_vocab_c2_11_010.explanation: 'Correo electrónico' est Le/La RAE-recommended Espagnol equivalent de 'email.' Pendant que 'email' et 'e-mail' sont widely used et understood, langue purists et formel writing style guides prefer Le/La native Espagnol term. Le/La humorous folk adaptation 'emilio' exists mais est not a serious alternative.
q_vocab_c2_11_010.context: A debate about linguistic purism versus natural language evolution

q_vocab_c2_12_001.question: Que 'escudriñar' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_12_001.correct: to scrutinize / to examine very carefully and thoroughly
wrong: to shield or protect from harm
to write quickly and carelessly
to escape from a difficult situation
q_vocab_c2_12_001.explanation: 'Escudriñar' signifie à examine ou investigate something avec great attention à detail. Il implies a thorough, meticulous search ou analysis. Il est utilisé dans literary, journalistic, et academic contexts.

q_vocab_c2_12_002.question: El ponente ___ sus argumentos con datos estadísticos contundentes.
wrong: apuntó
apartó
aplazó
q_vocab_c2_12_002.explanation: 'Apuntalar' signifie 'à shore up' ou 'à buttress' (les deux literally et figuratively). Dans discourse, 'apuntalar un argumento' signifie à reinforce an argument avec strong supporting evidence. 'Apuntar' signifie à point/note, 'apartar' signifie à move aside, et 'aplazar' signifie à postpone.

q_vocab_c2_12_003.question: Que 'ahondar' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_12_003.correct: to delve deeper / to explore in greater depth
wrong: to drown or submerge
to save or rescue
to shorten or abbreviate
q_vocab_c2_12_003.explanation: 'Ahondar' (de 'hondo,' deep) signifie à go deeper into a topic, issue, ou analysis. 'Ahondar en un tema' est a commun collocation dans academic et journalistic Espagnol sens 'à explore a subject more deeply.'

q_vocab_c2_12_004.question: Que 'abogar' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_12_004.correct: to advocate / to argue in favor of something
wrong: to abolish a law or practice
to abandon a position or place
to absorb or take in completely
q_vocab_c2_12_004.explanation: 'Abogar' (related à 'abogado,' lawyer) signifie à advocate pour ou plead dans favor de a cause, policy, ou personne. 'Abogar por los derechos humanos' signifie 'à advocate pour human rights.'

q_vocab_c2_12_005.question: We doit eradicate corruption à tous levels de government.
q_vocab_c2_12_005.correct: Debemos erradicar la corrupción en todos los niveles de gobierno.
wrong: Debemos eliminar la competencia en todos los niveles de gobierno.
Debemos erradicar la corrupción en algunos niveles de gobierno.
Debemos erradicar la educación en todos los niveles de gobierno.
q_vocab_c2_12_005.explanation: 'Erradicar' signifie 'à eradicate' ou 'à root out completely.' Il est a formel, high-register verbe used dans political, medical, et social discourse. Il implies complete elimination, not just reduction.

q_vocab_c2_12_006.question: Que 'resquicio' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_12_006.correct: a crack, gap, or loophole (literal or figurative)
wrong: a residue or leftover
a requirement or prerequisite
a resentment or grudge
q_vocab_c2_12_006.explanation: 'Resquicio' literally signifie a narrow crack ou opening, mais figuratively il se réfère à n'importe quel petit opportunity, loophole, ou remaining trace. 'Un resquicio legal' signifie 'a legal loophole,' et 'un resquicio de esperanza' signifie 'a glimmer de hope.'

q_vocab_c2_12_007.question: A news article states: 'Las negociaciones han llegado a un punto muerto.' Que 'punto muerto' signifier ici?
q_vocab_c2_12_007.correct: a deadlock / an impasse (negotiations have stalled)
wrong: a critical moment requiring urgent action
a successful conclusion of the talks
a death toll from the conflict
q_vocab_c2_12_007.explanation: 'Punto muerto' (literally 'dead point') signifie 'deadlock' ou 'impasse,' indicating Cela no further progress peut être made. Dans automotive contexts, il signifie 'neutral gear.' Ici, applied à negotiations, il signifie talks avoir completely stalled.
q_vocab_c2_12_007.context: Reading a news article about diplomatic negotiations

q_vocab_c2_12_008.question: Que 'desistir' signifier?
q_vocab_c2_12_008.correct: to desist / to give up or abandon an attempt
wrong: to desire or wish for something strongly
to design or plan something carefully
to dissect or analyze in parts
q_vocab_c2_12_008.explanation: 'Desistir' signifie à cease an effort, à give up sur a plan ou intention. Dans legal contexts, 'desistir de una demanda' signifie à withdraw a lawsuit. Il implies a conscious decision à stop pursuing something.

q_vocab_c2_12_009.question: A pesar de las adversidades, el pueblo no cejó en su empeño por alcanzar la libertad.
q_vocab_c2_12_009.correct: Despite the adversities, the people did not relent in their determination to achieve freedom.
wrong: Despite the adversities, the people did not celebrate their attempt to achieve freedom.
Because of the adversities, the people gave up their effort to achieve freedom.
Despite the adversities, the people did not begin their fight for freedom.
q_vocab_c2_12_009.explanation: 'Cejar en su empeño' signifie 'à relent dans one's effort/determination.' 'No cejar' signifie 'à persist, à not give up.' 'A pesar de' signifie 'despite.' Ceci est un formel, literary construction typical de C2-level texts.

q_vocab_c2_12_010.question: Vous sont writing a conclusion pour a formel essay et want pour dire Cela Le/La evidence overwhelmingly supports Le/La thesis. Quel expression est Le/La la plupart appropriate pour academic register?
q_vocab_c2_12_010.correct: Los datos recabados avalan de forma fehaciente la tesis planteada.
wrong: Los datos que hemos encontrado demuestran que tenemos razón.
Está claro que la tesis es correcta porque los datos lo dicen.
Todo lo que hemos visto confirma lo que dijimos al principio.
q_vocab_c2_12_010.explanation: 'Recabados' (gathered/collected), 'avalan' (endorse/support), et 'de forma fehaciente' (dans an unequivocal/reliable manner) sont tous high-register academic terms. 'Tesis planteada' (thesis put forward) est Le/La formel way à refer back à Le/La main argument. Ce level de formality est expected dans C2-level academic writing.
q_vocab_c2_12_010.context: Writing the conclusion of a formal academic essay
